arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Garre argued the Age Discrimination Act does not prohibit retaliation.
Mr. Guerra argued federal workers lack remedies for age retaliation.
Justice Scalia questioned if plain language covers retaliation.
Chief Justice Roberts noted the complexity of existing civil service remedies.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: The case tests whether federal employees can sue directly for age-based retaliation. The government argues the Civil Service Reform Act handles these disputes. the side that brought the case argues the Age Discrimination Act allows direct court access.
